sources.utf8_bytes_source: function utf8(s){const a=[];for(const c of s){let n=c.codePointAt(0);if(n>=0xd800&&n<=0xdfff)n=0xfffd;if(n<128)a.push(n);else if(n<2048)a.push(192|(n>>6),128|(n&63));else if(n<65536)a.push(224|(n>>12),128|((n>>6)&63),128|(n&63));else a.push(240|(n>>18),128|((n>>12)&63),128|((n>>6)&63),128|(n&63));}return new Uint8Array(a);}
sources.sha1_bytes_source: function sha1(bytes){const len=bytes.length,n=((len+9+63)>>6)<<6,b=new Uint8Array(n);b.set(bytes);b[len]=128;const bit=len*8,hi=Math.floor(bit/4294967296),lo=bit>>>0;for(let j=0;j<4;j++){b[n-8+j]=(hi>>>(24-j*8))&255;b[n-4+j]=(lo>>>(24-j*8))&255;}let h0=0x67452301,h1=0xefcdab89,h2=0x98badcfe,h3=0x10325476,h4=0xc3d2e1f0;const w=new Int32Array(80),rol=(x,n)=>(x<<n)|(x>>>(32-n));for(let p=0;p<n;p+=64){for(let t=0;t<16;t++)w[t]=(b[p+4*t]<<24)|(b[p+4*t+1]<<16)|(b[p+4*t+2]<<8)|b[p+4*t+3];for(let t=16;t<80;t++)w[t]=rol(w[t-3]^w[t-8]^w[t-14]^w[t-16],1);let a=h0,c=h2,d=h3,e=h4,bb=h1;for(let t=0;t<80;t++){const f=t<20?(bb&c)|(~bb&d):t<40?bb^c^d:t<60?(bb&c)|(bb&d)|(c&d):bb^c^d,k=t<20?0x5a827999:t<40?0x6ed9eba1:t<60?0x8f1bbcdc:0xca62c1d6,x=(rol(a,5)+f+e+k+w[t])|0;e=d;d=c;c=rol(bb,30);bb=a;a=x;}h0=(h0+a)|0;h1=(h1+bb)|0;h2=(h2+c)|0;h3=(h3+d)|0;h4=(h4+e)|0;}return [h0,h1,h2,h3,h4].map(x=>(x>>>0).toString(16).padStart(8,"0")).join("");}
sources.verify_style_source: function verify(actual,expected){function norm(v){if(v===undefined)return undefined;const s=String(v).trim();if(["transparent","#0000","#00000000","rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)","rgba(0,0,0,0)"].includes(s))return "transparent";if(/^0(?:px)?$/.test(s))return "0";return s.replace(/\s+/g," ");}return Object.entries(expected).every(([k,v])=>{if(v==="none"&&actual[k]===undefined)return true;return norm(actual[k])===norm(v);});}
sources.minimum_policy_source: function minPolicy(t,nodes,parentContext){const by=new Map(nodes.map(n=>[n.id,n])),a=[];for(const n of nodes)for(const key of ["minWidth","minHeight"]){if(!/^0(?:px)?$/.test(String(n.styles[key])))continue;const ps=n===nodes[0]?parentContext?.styles:by.get(n.parentId)?.styles;let cursor=n,exception=["absolute","fixed"].includes(n.styles.position);while(cursor){if((cursor.styles.aspectRatio!==undefined&&cursor.styles.aspectRatio!=="auto")||(cursor.styles.writingMode!==undefined&&cursor.styles.writingMode!=="horizontal-tb"))exception=true;cursor=by.get(cursor.parentId);}const axis=ps?.flexDirection??"row",cross=!exception&&["flex","inline-flex"].includes(ps?.display)&&((key==="minWidth"&&axis.startsWith("column"))||(key==="minHeight"&&axis.startsWith("row")));a.push({nodeId:n.id,property:key,value:n.styles[key],parentId:n.parentId,root:n===nodes[0],crossAxisEquivalent:cross});}return a;}
